gloss: to mock; to ridicule; to sneer at

definitions.gloss: to mock; to ridicule; to sneer at
definitions.explanation: To make fun of someone in a contemptuous or scornful way.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{嘲|あざけ}った。
{嘲|あざけ}るような{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}が{聞|き}こえた。
{他人|たにん}の{努力|どりょく}を{嘲|あざけ}るのは{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: It's not good to mock others' efforts.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb (他動詞). The person/thing being mocked takes を.

RELATED FORMS:
・{嘲|あざけ}り - mockery, ridicule (noun)
・{嘲笑|ちょうしょう} - derision, mockery (Sino-Japanese compound)

COMPARISON:
・{嘲|あざけ}る - to mock, ridicule (contemptuous)
・からかう - to tease (often playful)
・{馬鹿|ばか}にする - to make a fool of, look down on
・{冷|ひ}やかす - to tease, make fun of

USAGE:
This word has a negative connotation, implying contempt or cruelty. It's stronger than からかう (to tease).
